changeSet.sql: UPDATE REQUEST_ACTION SET payload = payload || jsonb_build_object('changesDetails', NULL) WHERE TYPE IN ('BATCH_REISSUE_SUBMITTED','BATCH_REISSUE_COMPLETED','REISSUE_COMPLETED') AND NOT jsonb_exists(payload, 'changesDetails');

rollback.sql: UPDATE REQUEST_ACTION SET payload = payload - 'changesDetails' WHERE TYPE IN ('BATCH_REISSUE_SUBMITTED','BATCH_REISSUE_COMPLETED','REISSUE_COMPLETED') AND jsonb_exists(payload, 'changesDetails') AND ((payload->'changesDetails') IS NULL OR (payload->'changesDetails') = 'null'::jsonb);
